# `needless-defer-block`

<!-- rule-docs:header (generated by `zig build rule-docs`) -->
Tier: style · Profile: idiomatic · Default: off · Fixes: fix all · Options: none

Reports a `defer` or `errdefer` block containing only one expression statement.
<!-- /rule-docs:header -->

## Why it matters

The direct form is shorter and makes the deferred operation visible without an
extra block.

## When it fires

It applies only to a single expression whose block can be removed without
changing scope or declarations.

<!-- rule-docs:footer (generated by `zig build rule-docs`) -->
## Example

```zig
fn cleanup() void {}

fn f() void {
    defer {
        cleanup();
    }
}
```
